title: EU-India Climate Expert Workshop
description: The workshop will bring together Indian and European participants to exchange experiences on environmental challenges, discuss climate cooperation and explore the role of civil society in shaping shared solutions.

title: European perspectives on German rearmament: Reassurance or concern?
description: Since Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine, Germany has been on a clear path to rearmament. Now, it aims to build Europe's strongest conventional army by 2039.
